title: Jakarta source contracts
scope: Selected integrated capabilities and inspected candidates. Not a count of all Jakarta open datasets.
datePolicy: dataAsOf is publisher observation/snapshot period where known; checkedAt is retrieval/probe only. Unknown epochs remain null.

statusDefinitions.integrated: Existing dashboard/atlas capability or committed reference asset; does not imply live or all-record availability.
statusDefinitions.candidate: Public source found or probed; not admitted as a current integrated dataset.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Recorded access failure; no inference about city conditions.
statusDefinitions.registration-required: Key/account required; no credential provisioned or current coverage verified.

records.name: Five-station ISPU historical batches
records.publisher: Dinas Lingkungan Hidup DKI Jakarta · Satu Data Jakarta
records.license: Publisher attribution; explicit dataset license not stated in inspected metadata
records.limitations: Daily SPKU measurements republished by the publisher in monthly batches; the latest batch is dated, not live. No values are interpolated for no-data days. Latest publisher batch: 2025-11.

records.name: Investment project proposals
records.license: Public reference; no dataset-specific open license stated
records.limitations: Dated public reference; retrieval date is not an observation date. No live capacity or operation inferred.

records.name: Annual flood-prone-point reference
records.publisher: Satuan Polisi Pamong Praja · Satu Data Jakarta
records.license: Terbuka; attribution; dataset-specific reuse license not stated
records.limitations: Dated public reference; retrieval date is not an observation date. No live capacity or operation inferred.

records.name: Mapped city waterways
records.license: ODbL
records.limitations: All returned mapped river/canal/stream/drain/ditch ways and natural-water ways in bbox. Not every physical drain; multipolygon relations and upstream geometry outside bbox are not included. OSM way order is not measured flow direction.

records.name: Connected Ciliwung scenario corridor
records.license: ODbL, © OpenStreetMap contributors
records.limitations: Endpoint tolerance is how far a scenario station may sit from the nearest mapped river node; the chord bound keeps a path near the station-to-station line. No invented connectors; gaps remain schematic and labelled. Scenario timing is a separate historical assumption, not derived hydraulic speed.

records.name: Public camera location references
records.publisher: Public ArcGIS CCTV Jakarta 2019 catalog / Balitower links
records.license: No explicit redistribution license in catalog; publisher attribution and source links. Video remains on provider.
records.limitations: Coordinates are catalog locations, not verified current camera positions. Links do not establish uptime; HTTPS playback may fail. No congestion/speed measurement.

records.name: BPBD hourly gauge reference
records.publisher: BPBD DKI Jakarta / Dinas SDA Prov. DKI Jakarta
records.license: Publisher attribution; dataset-specific open license not stated
records.limitations: Dated public reference; retrieval date is not an observation date. No live capacity or operation inferred.

records.name: Official kelurahan weather forecast
records.license: Public API; BMKG attribution and published API restrictions
records.limitations: Issue and valid times separate; forecast is not an observed rain gauge

records.name: Official regional weather warnings
records.license: BMKG attribution; no general redistribution license asserted
records.limitations: DKI/Jawa Barat/Banten scope; expired or incomplete alerts rejected

records.name: CAMS modeled current air quality
records.license: CC BY 4.0 data; attribution required; free hosted service restricted to noncommercial use
records.limitations: Global CAMS approximately 45km; API interpolation is not measured hourly street data; US AQI is not ISPU

records.name: Modeled weather and wind
records.license: CC BY 4.0 data; attribution required; free hosted service restricted to noncommercial use
records.limitations: Returned model grid and units validated; wind FROM bearing is inverted for illustrative transport

records.name: Public river gauges and separate discharge predictions
records.license: No general open license stated
records.limitations: Local-datum levels are not discharge; serial predicted sections are never summed; no credential-bearing endpoints

records.name: TE-Global discharge/flood fraction
records.license: Provider product terms apply; attribution retained
records.limitations: Approximately 0.1° / 10 km; satellite-informed model, not observed urban flood extent

records.name: Dated aerosol, precipitation, surface-water and cloud images
records.license: Original dataset terms apply; NASA/JMA attribution
records.limitations: MODIS flood classification 250 m; clouds/narrow water limit detection; AOD is column aerosol, not surface PM concentration

records.name: Recent aggregate flood reports
records.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial agreement required
records.limitations: No report does not establish dry streets; no resident text/photos copied

records.name: Official citizen-response hosted reports
records.license: Publisher-hosted reports; no dataset reuse license asserted
records.limitations: On-demand official iframe/links; private complaints are not imported

records.name: Public toll-camera video catalogue
records.license: No video redistribution license asserted; source player/pass-through only
records.limitations: 21 unique catalogue streams; uptime and framecapture time vary; no recording or invented coordinates

records.name: Reported flood-area polygons
records.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial agreement required
records.useCase: Compare reported affected areas with satellite extent
records.limitations: One state 2 feature returned, last updated 2024-09-27. Not current flood evidence. State1unknown; state 2=10–70cm; state 3=71–150cm; state 4>150cm. Reject stale/future records for current view.

records.name: Passengers served per day
records.license: Not stated in inspected landing page

records.verification: HTTP200 HTML; no data rows inspected

records.limitations: Landing page access does not verify export endpoint, period, units, operator breakdown or license; no metrics imported.

records.name: Budget and public planning portal
records.license: No dataset-specific reuse license verified

records.limitations: No numerical budget records imported; API/download contract and fiscal basis remain unverified.

records.name: Official flood monitoring portal
records.license: Dataset-specific redistribution license not verified
records.verification: Existing recorded timeout; not reprobed today
records.useCase: Official current levels and operations if access resumes
records.limitations: Earlier HTTP/HTTPS checks timed out; no current feed imported. Blocked access is not no-flood.

records.name: Normalized air-monitoring observations
records.license: Dataset-specific source terms; attribution required
records.verification: Candidate only; no Jakarta station/API probe in this audit
records.limitations: No verified Jakarta coverage, uptime or current readings. Do not label integrated or live.

records.name: NOAA-20 VIIRS regional thermal anomalies
records.license: NASA FIRMS product attribution; exact reuse terms not independently verified
records.verification: Anonymous provider retrieval and local adapter/UI verified; published detections retain individual dates
records.useCase: Regional haze context with dated thermal detections and independent NOAA-20 true-colour comparison
records.limitations: Nominal 375 m anomalies may be industrial heat. FRP MW is not PM mass. Only validated records within 24 hours are admitted; each detection retains its observation time. Endpoint availability does not confirm fire, smoke source or clean air. Local adapter/UI verified; deployment verification is separate.

records.name: CAMS modeled 48-hour air timeline
records.license: CC BY 4.0 data; attribution required; free hosted service restricted to noncommercial use
records.useCase: Compare time-varying PM2.5/PM10/AOD/dust with wind scenario
records.limitations: Global CAMS approximately 45 km. Hourly output is interpolated from a coarser native model cadence; AOD is not surface PM concentration. Valid times are returned dynamically.

records.name: Historical water-arrival preparedness scenario
records.publisher: BPBD DKI Jakarta · preparedness guide (2021); Jakarta Satu station inventory
records.license: BPBD historical public reference; route ODbL, OpenStreetMap contributors
records.dataAsOf: 2021 historical timing reference; mapped route snapshot 2026-10-13
records.access: committed assets; original direct PDF access previously blocked
records.verification: Committed scenario and route contracts inspected
records.useCase: Explore station-to-station timing along admitted mapped river geometry
records.limitations: No terrain, discharge, cross-sections, tide, pump capacities or calibrated hydraulics. No inundation depth or street flooding predicted. Timing assumptions remain separate from mapped river length. Schematic fallback stays labelled.
